{
  "name": "ruflo-ai-team",
  "description": "Give Claude a tenant-isolated AI team that divides work, coordinates progress, recalls approved context, and returns evidence-backed results.",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "ruvnet",
    "url": "https://github.com/ruvnet"
  },
  "homepage": "https://team.ruv.io",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://team.ruv.io/privacy",
  "supportUrl": "https://team.ruv.io/support",
  "repository": "https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/tree/main/plugins/ruflo-ai-team",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://team.ruv.io/terms",
  "icon": ".claude-plugin/icon.svg",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "ruflo",
    "ai-team",
    "multi-agent",
    "automation",
    "ruvector",
    "mcp",
    "mod",
    "function-hooks"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "guard": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AI Team guard",
      "description": "Refuse what goes into team memory and task or run records (memory_remember, task_create, task_update, run_create on the ruflo-ai-team server) that hold a key, token or password.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  }
}
